interpolate_values_with_easing: interpolate between two numeric values using a named easing function like bounce or elastic
get_easing_function_by_name: get an easing function by name from the EASING_FUNCTIONS dictionary for animation timing
calculate_arc_motion: calculate a position along a parabolic arc between two points with a given height
apply_squash_stretch: apply squash and stretch scaling to animation dimensions with configurable intensity and direction
use_back_easing_overshoot: use back easing functions to create overshoot and anticipate effects in animations
